title: The big park: an adjective before the place

sections.title: Adjective, noun, ending
sections.content: The adjective goes before the noun and never changes, just as in unit 11. The ending goes on the noun only, which is the last word of the phrase: *a nagy park* becomes *a nagy parkba*. The article follows the first sound of the whole phrase, so it is *az új étterembe*, because *új* begins with a vowel.

items.english: Anna is going to the big park.
I am going to the new restaurant.

items.spanish: Hová mész? A kicsi kávézóba megyek.
items.english: Where are you going? I am going to the small café.
Meg is going to the beautiful garden.

sections.content: The adjective is never given *-ba* or *-be*: not *a nagyba parkba*. Say the phrase in this order: article, adjective, noun with the ending. Check the article by the first word after it, not by the noun: *az új étterembe*, but *a régi étterembe*.
